pages.title: Aetherium Vanguard — Project Overview
pages.purpose: High-level introduction to the game, its architecture, technology stack, and how the codebase is organized. Links to all major child sections for deeper exploration.

pages.title: Getting Started: Build & Run
pages.purpose: Step-by-step guide for setting up the MSYS2 UCRT64 environment, building the game with build.ps1, running game.exe, and understanding the two build profiles (development vs. release).

pages.title: CI/CD and Release Pipeline
pages.purpose: Documents the GitHub Actions workflow that automates building, tagging, and publishing game.exe releases. Covers workflow inputs, MSYS2 provisioning, artifact upload, and the git-tagging convention.

pages.title: Codebase Refactor History & Plans
pages.purpose: Explains the origin of the project (single-file game.c → modular src/ split), the decisions recorded in plans/dplan.md, and the planned raylib 6.0 migration documented in plans/raylib6-migration.md.

pages.title: Core Architecture
pages.purpose: Overview of the global-state design pattern, the GameData singleton, the frame lifecycle, and how all modules interact through game.h. Links to child pages for each major subsystem.

pages.title: GameData: Global State & Data Structures
pages.purpose: Deep dive into cgame.h — all enums (GameState, TowerType, EnemyType, DamageType, StatusEffect), all structs (GameData, Hero, Tower, Enemy, Projectile, Particle, FloatingText, GridCell, GameMap), configuration constants, and the extern game singleton pattern.

pages.title: Initialization, Map Generation & Game Loop
pages.purpose: Covers main.c: the main() entry point, InitGame(), ResetGame() (memset-based entity pool clearing, starting resources), InitMap() (hardcoded tile path and waypoint extraction), BuildStaticMapRT() (pre-rendered map RenderTexture), and the 60 FPS game loop with dt capping.

pages.title: Update Loop & State Machine
pages.purpose: Documents update.c: the UpdateGame() dispatcher, all GameState transitions (GS_TITLE → GS_PLAYING → GS_PAUSED / GS_LEVEL_UP_HERO / GS_GAME_OVER), UpdatePlaying() sequencing, HandleInput() with coordinate mapping and tower hotkeys, and UpdateEnvironment() (day/night cycle, screen shake).

pages.title: Entity Systems
pages.purpose: Overview of all active game entities — hero, towers, enemies, and projectiles — and how they interact through the shared GameData state. Links to child pages for each entity type.

pages.title: Hero System
pages.purpose: Documents hero.c: ApplyHeroSkills() attribute scaling, UpdateHero() movement (WASD), dash mechanic (Q), standard attack (Space), Aether Burst (E / DMG_TRUE + STATUS_WEAKEN), GrantHeroXP(), LevelUpHero(), and the four hero skills (SKILL_VIGOR, SKILL_AGILITY, SKILL_BURST_MASTERY, SKILL_LEADERSHIP).

pages.title: Tower System
pages.purpose: Documents towers.c: all four base tower types and eight T4 specializations, UpdateTowers() targeting pipeline (TARGET_FIRST/CLOSEST/STRONGEST/WEAKEST), PlaceTower(), SellTower(), UpgradeTower(), ConfigureTowerStats() scaling, GrantXP(), LevelUpTower(), rotation/aiming logic, and the SKILL_LEADERSHIP XP synergy.

pages.title: Enemy System & Spatial Grid
pages.purpose: Documents enemies.c: all eight EnemyType archetypes, UpdateEnemies() waypoint movement, SpawnEnemy() with wave scaling and path-snapping, CalculateDamage() (armor/energyResist mitigation, DMG_TRUE bypass), ApplyStatusEffect() with boss resistance, ProcessStatusEffects() pipeline, HandleEnemyDeath() rewards, and the RebuildEnemyGrid() / GetEnemiesInRadius() spatial partitioning system.

pages.title: Projectile System
pages.purpose: Documents projectiles.c: FireProjectile() free-list allocation and predictive mortar targeting, UpdateProjectiles() movement and collision detection, HandleProjectileImpact() with chain lightning (TOWER_T4_TESLA_CHAIN hitHistory), AoE resolution, and ApplyDamageAndEffects() with critical hit chance and status effect propagation.

pages.title: Wave Progression System
pages.purpose: Documents waves.c: ManageWaves() state machine (inter-wave timer vs. active spawning), enemy type probability tiers by wave number, boss wave and spawner wave logic, spawn interval scaling, wave completion detection, and gold/aether reward formulas.

pages.title: Rendering & Visual Effects
pages.purpose: Overview of the two-pass rendering architecture (static map RenderTexture + dynamic entity draw calls), the batched circle rendering optimization, and the VFX subsystem. Links to child pages for draw pipeline and VFX.

pages.title: Draw Pipeline
pages.purpose: Documents draw.c: DrawGame() state-driven dispatch, DrawMap() with RenderTexture caching, DrawEnemies() with health bars and status tints, DrawTowers() including Cryo beam and Tesla sparkle effects, DrawProjectiles() with batched triangle-fan energy projectiles, DrawHero() with AoE indicators, and the rendering order (map → entities → VFX → UI).

pages.title: VFX System: Particles, Floating Text & Screen Shake
pages.purpose: Documents vfx.c: UpdateVFX() physics simulation (gravity, damping), DrawVFX() batched rlBegin/RL_TRIANGLES rendering with EmitCircleFan, SpawnParticles() two-pass free-list allocation, AddFloatingText() / AddFloatingTextFmt() with critical flag, ScreenShake() intensity gating, and environmentColor tinting.

pages.title: UI System
pages.purpose: Documents ui.c: DrawUI() with interactive flag, the Build Menu (tower selection, gold feedback), Tower Inspector (stats, targeting mode, upgrade paths), GuiButton() hover/click primitive, SetTooltip() / DrawTooltip() with screen-edge clamping, and the Hero Level-Up panel (GS_LEVEL_UP_HERO skill selection).

pages.title: Utility Layer
pages.purpose: Documents utils.c: spatial conversion (WorldToTile, TileToWorldCenter, IsTileBuildable, ClosestPointOnSegment), entity lookup (GetEnemyById, GetEnemyFromPair), tower metadata (GetTowerCost, GetTowerAetherCost, GetTowerName, GetTowerDescription, GetTowerColor, GetAimToleranceDegrees), angle math (LerpAngle, GetAngleDifference), and the EmitCircleFan precomputed unit-circle optimization.

pages.title: Testing Infrastructure
pages.purpose: Overview of the headless test strategy: how raylib_stub replaces the GPU dependency, how run_tests.sh orchestrates compilation with gcov coverage, and the test utility helpers. Links to child pages for the stub and the test harness.

pages.title: raylib_stub: Headless Raylib Replacement
pages.purpose: Documents raylib_stub.c and raylib_stub.h in detail: Test Control API (StubResetInput, StubPressKey, StubClickMouse, StubSetMousePosition, StubSetFrameTime, StubSetRandomValue, StubSetRandomSeed), Draw-Call Log (StubDrawCall, StubDrawKind, StubResetDrawLog, StubDrawLogCount, StubDrawLogAt), RLGL Activity Log (StubRlBeginCount, StubRlVertexCount), frame lifecycle (EndDrawing clears pressed buffers), deterministic LCG RNG, and RenderTexture stub.

pages.title: Test Harness: run_tests.sh & Test Utilities
pages.purpose: Documents run_tests.sh (compilation pipeline, -Dmain=game_renamed_main symbol renaming, gcov instrumentation, 80% coverage threshold enforcement), test_util.h (CHECK/CHECK_NEAR/CHECK_STREQ macros, ResetForTest(), PlaceEnemyExact vs SpawnEnemyAt, CountActive* helpers, StubFindText/StubFindCircle/StubFindLine search functions), and the per-module test files (test_hero.c, test_towers.c, test_enemies.c, test_projectiles.c, test_waves_update.c, test_draw_ui.c, test_vfx.c).

pages.title: Glossary
pages.purpose: Definitions of all codebase-specific terms, abbreviations, game-design concepts, and technical jargon that an onboarding engineer needs to understand. Each entry includes the relevant file or struct/function name as a code pointer.
